Feature: Ores: bauxite, lead, silver, nickel, uranium
What it does: Five ore types; smelt to aluminium, lead, silver, nickel, uranium ingots.
Interactions & automation: Pickaxe tiers: bauxite stone+, others iron+. Raw ore → grit via crusher/hammer.
Default numbers: Y ranges: bauxite 32–112, lead −32–80, silver −48–32, nickel −64–24 (deep nickel to −120), uranium −64–−16
Create-style extension idea: Don't add ores; consume c: tags (ingots/steel, ingots/aluminum…) so any materials mod feeds the machines. Ship optional ores behind config.

Feature: Industrial hemp → tough fabric / ersatz leather
What it does: Two-block crop; fibre → tough fabric; fabric + plant oil/wax → ersatz leather. Fabric used in sails, balloons, cushions.
Interactions & automation: Seeds from grass; grows in cloche.
Create-style extension idea: Optional crop; real value is the fabric/leather intermediate. Could reuse vanilla string/wool via a Create mechanical-crafter 'weaving' recipe.

What it does: Planks impregnated with creosote; base construction material for IE.
Interactions & automation: Crafted by hand with a creosote bucket.
Create-style extension idea: Spout creosote onto planks on a belt (filling recipe) or bulk-dip in a basin — classic Create automation step.

What it does: Plates from hammer or press; rods from press; wires from cutting plates or press.
Interactions & automation: Hand tools (hammer/cutters) or Metal Press molds.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Press makes iron/gold/copper/brass sheets; no rods or wire
Create-style extension idea: Press dies (see Metal Press) + a kinetic Rolling Mill for rods and wire.

What it does: Steel from blast furnaces; electrum (gold+silver) and constantan (copper+nickel) from kiln, arc furnace or grit.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Brass via heated mixing; no steel
Create-style extension idea: Electrum/constantan = heated mixing recipes (cheap). Steel needs its own furnace chain (see Blast Furnace).

What it does: Creosote, redstone acid, plant oil, ethanol, biodiesel, high-cetane biodiesel, acetaldehyde, phenolic resin, herbicide, liquid concrete, potion fluid.
Interactions & automation: Made in coke oven, mixer, squeezer, fermenter, refinery.
Create-style extension idea: Register fluids under c: tags; all production via basin/spout/mixer where possible.

What it does: Lead converted to white/red dye.
Create-style extension idea: Out of scope.

Feature: Byproducts: sulfur, nitrate, slag; fertilizer; gunpowder
What it does: Sulfur from crushing coal/quartz/lapis/blaze rods; nitrate from crushing sandstone; slag from steelmaking. Combine into fertilizer or gunpowder.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Crushing gives XP nuggets/byproducts but no sulfur/nitrate/slag
Create-style extension idea: Add as crushing-wheel chance outputs; slag as a blast-furnace byproduct that must be removed (belt/funnel out).

Feature: Crafting components (engineering blocks, mechanical/electronic components, vacuum tubes, circuit backplane)
What it does: Intermediate parts for machines; advanced ones need blueprints in the workbench.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Precision mechanism via sequenced assembly; casings
Create-style extension idea: Replace blueprints with sequenced-assembly chains (press → deploy → spout) — the Create idiom for complex parts.

Feature: Coke, coke dust, HOP graphite, graphite electrodes
What it does: Coal → coke (coke oven). 8 coke dust → HOP graphite (squeezer). Graphite → electrodes / plates (bottling + mold).
Create-style extension idea: Coke from a Coking Oven; graphite via compacting; electrodes as consumables for the arc crucible.

What it does: Ethanol→acetaldehyde (silver catalyst) + creosote → phenolic resin → duroplast sheets/blocks via molds. Sawdust + resin → fiberboard.
Create-style extension idea: Plastics tier: resin via catalysed mixing, duroplast via spout onto a mold on a belt.

What it does: Structural Engineer, Machinist, Electrician, Gunsmith, Outfitter with IE workstations.
Interactions & automation: Workstations: turntable, crafting table, circuit table, workbench, shader banner.
Create-style extension idea: Optional later.

What it does: Forms multiblocks, configures sides, crushes ores by hand.
Interactions & automation: Right-click a key block to form a multiblock; sneak to target opposite side.
Create-style extension idea: Keep the Wrench. Form multiblocks Create-style by placement (like tanks/vaults/boilers) — no hammer step.

What it does: Remove wires; invert redstone/fine config; read energy and wire loss.
Create-style extension idea: Readouts go on Engineer's Goggles tooltips (fluid, heat, fill).

What it does: Portable inventory with typed slots; placeable.
Carries 10 B of fluid; pours into machines/world; refills tools in crafting grid.
Interactions & automation: Fill from tanks; cannot scoop from world.
Create-style extension idea: Fluid canister filled by spout, emptied by item drain.

What it does: Sound reduction; field upgrades for tools.
Ride along wires/ropes like a zipline; upgrades for climbing and insulation.
Create-style extension idea: Only meaningful if a wire/cable system exists.

What it does: Fuel-powered area mining / tree-felling; swappable heads and upgrades (augers, lubrication, tanks, rockcutter, grinding disk).
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Mechanical drill/saw on contraptions; backtank-powered tools
Create-style extension idea: Backtank-pressurised hand tools fit Create better than fuel tanks.

What it does: Wearable energy store charging held tools; antenna, induction charger, magnet, tesla upgrades.
Create-style extension idea: Backtank already fills this role for Create tools.

What it does: Cheap elytra; cosmetic skins for tools/carts/banners.
27-slot crate that keeps contents when sealed and broken; reinforced = explosion-proof.
12 B tanks; metal accepts hot fluids and gases, redstone stops output.
Crates/barrels in carts that keep behaviour.

Feature: Conveyor belts (basic, redstone, dropping, extracting, vertical, splitting, covered)
What it does: Unpowered belts move items/entities; variants drop, extract, lift vertically, alternate split, or hide items.
Interactions & automation: Hammer rotates/sets slope; screwdriver sets extract speed; dye recolours.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Mechanical belt, funnels, brass tunnels (split), chutes + fan (vertical), smart chute

What it does: Fabric curtain that hides openings and emits redstone when crossed.
Create-style extension idea: Small decorative detector; cheap add.

What it does: Right-click pulls the first stack out of the attached inventory.
Drop items/entities straight down; corner variant.
Six-sided filter router with tag/damage/component options.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Brass tunnels + funnels with filters, smart chute, attribute filters

What it does: Collects a full batch before releasing; per-filter redstone on coloured channels.

Feature: Fluid pipes, pump, valve, router, outlet
What it does: Pipes split flow evenly; powered pump pressurises; pump drains world fluids (leaves cobble); valve blocks flow on redstone; router filters by fluid; outlet spills into world.
Interactions & automation: Hammer toggles connections; dye; scaffold covers.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Fluid pipe, mechanical pump, fluid valve, smart fluid pipe, hose pulley

What it does: Liquid concrete spreads and sets in the world (traps mobs); leaded concrete blocks teleporting; reinforced is wither-proof.
Interactions & automation: Mixed in the mixer; poured with a bucket or chem thrower.
Default numbers: Mixer: 500 mB water + gravel + clay + 2 sand
Create-style extension idea: Liquid concrete mixed in a basin, poured by hose pulley — strong Create showpiece.

Feature: Clinker brick, slag products (gravel, glass, bricks)
What it does: Decorative bricks; slag glass dims light; slag gravel speeds aquatic growth.
Create-style extension idea: Slag as a byproduct sink.

Feature: Posts, wallmounts, catwalks, scaffolding, metal ladders, steel/treated doors, signs, warning signs, factory windows, sheetmetal, metal fences, structural connectors
What it does: Industrial building set; posts carry wires; catwalks take railings; steel doors lock on redstone; windows can lie flat as skylights.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Girders, scaffolds, ladders, doors, framed glass, industrial iron, placards
Create-style extension idea: Catwalks and flat skylights are the notable gaps.

Feature: Lighting: lanterns, cage lamps, powered lantern, floodlight
What it does: Powered lantern stops hostile spawns in a 32-block radius; floodlight casts a 32-block cone.
Interactions & automation: Screwdriver adjusts brightness/inverts redstone; hammer aims floodlight.
Create-style extension idea: Rotation-driven arc lamp if you want powered lighting without electricity.

What it does: Floating light source with rope anchors; dyeable stripes.
Crafting table that keeps the grid contents, plus a drawer.
Create-style extension idea: Trivial QoL block; optional.

What it does: Crafts blueprint-defined items (components, molds, ammo); also upgrades tools.
Interactions & automation: Blueprint in slot; six input slots.
Create-style extension idea: Map blueprint recipes to sequenced assembly.

What it does: Electrically heats adjacent vanilla furnaces so they need no fuel and can run 2× faster.
Interactions & automation: Hammer sets heated sides; redstone disables boost.
Default numbers: 8 Flux/t per furnace to keep warm, 24 Flux/t extra to double speed
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Blaze burner (basin/boiler heat); encased fan bulk smelting
Create-style extension idea: Friction heater: a kinetic block under/next to a furnace that heats it from rotation (stress cost scales with RPM).

What it does: Rotates the block in front by ±90°/180° on redstone.
Powered mini-greenhouse: water + seed + soil grows crops automatically; fertilisers boost.
Create-style extension idea: Kinetic hydroponic planter fed by spout water, harvested by deployer/harvester.

What it does: Charges energy items; comparator shows charge.
Create-style extension idea: Only if electricity is added.

What it does: Pulls nearby items while powered.
Create-style extension idea: Rotation-driven magnet — cheap to add.

Feature: Wire grid: copper/electrum/steel wires, connectors, relays, transformers, feedthroughs
What it does: Long-distance power over hanging wires with voltage tiers, loss per distance, transformers between tiers.
Interactions & automation: Coils click two connectors; transformers bridge tiers.
Default numbers: Copper 2,048 IF/t, 16 m, 1.25%/16 blocks; electrum 8,192 IF/t, 16 m, 0.3%; steel 32,768 IF/t, 32 m, 0.08%
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: None — Create moves power as rotation through shafts/belts/chains
Create-style extension idea: DECIDED 2026-11-18: pure rotation (SU). No FE layer. If long-distance power is needed later, use kinetic transmission (rope/cable drive, drive shafts).

What it does: Cut/measure power on wires.
Interactions & automation: Manual or redstone; comparator reads load.
Create-style extension idea: Kinetic equivalents already exist.

What it does: Energy storage with per-side I/O config.
Create-style extension idea: Kinetic storage: wind-up spring or flywheel battery that stores rotation and releases it.

What it does: Turns IE windmills/waterwheels into Flux.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Windmill bearing, water wheels, large water wheel, steam engine
Create-style extension idea: Create already does kinetic generation better.

What it does: Generates power from hot/cold block or fluid on opposite faces.
Create-style extension idea: Only relevant with electricity.

What it does: Burns liquid fuels for large power; outputs to up to 3 plugs.
Interactions & automation: Fuel at bottom corners; redstone stops it.
Default numbers: 4,096 Flux/t. Burn time per bucket: biodiesel 250, high-power biodiesel 275, creosote 20, diesel 322, sulfur diesel 285, kerosene 208
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Steam engine + boiler + blaze burner (solid fuel only)
Create-style extension idea: Diesel engine: a kinetic source that burns c: fuel tags, stacks like the steam engine, fuel value → SU and duration. Biggest-win Create addition.

What it does: Collects lightning into a burst of power; fence height raises strike chance.

Feature: Bundled redstone wiring (16 colours), state cell, timer, switchboard, probe connector
What it does: Coloured-channel redstone over wires; latches, timers, remapping, comparator probes.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Redstone link (frequency pairs), pulse timer/extender/repeater, latches
Create-style extension idea: Not core to the industry goal.

What it does: Compile logic gates onto circuits; unit runs 10 circuits with 8 registers.
Reads multiblock state (active, items, fluids, energy) to redstone, and accepts control signals.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Stockpile switch, display link, factory gauge
Create-style extension idea: Expose your machines to display links/stockpile switches instead.

What it does: Alarm sounds; wireless redstone over distance with frequencies 128–384 kHz.

Feature: Revolver + cartridges, railgun, chemical thrower, turrets, tesla coil, razor wire, heavy shield, gunpowder barrels
What it does: Combat and defence set.
Create-style extension idea: Out of scope for an industry pack — leave to IE or a separate addon.

What it does: Bulk storage for one item type.
Interactions & automation: Top grate/bottom port; redstone auto-output; layered comparators.

What it does: Bulk fluid store.
Holds crates/shulkers; automation by row/column.
Slow batch pyrolysis: coal → coke, logs → charcoal, plus creosote oil.
Interactions & automation: Hoppers/belts in/out; creosote needs pumping out.
Default numbers: 3,000–6,000 ticks/recipe; up to 16 coal / 8 logs per batch
Create-style extension idea: Coking Oven: brick chamber heated by a blaze burner, creosote drained by pipe/item drain. Placement-formed like Create tanks.

What it does: Fuel-fired alloying (electrum, constantan, insulating glass).
Create-style extension idea: Add heated mixing recipes.

Feature: Crude blast furnace → improved blast furnace + preheaters
What it does: Iron + coke → steel + slag. Crude: manual only. Improved: automated, steel out front / slag out back; preheaters speed it up.
Interactions & automation: Top hopper input; up to 2 preheaters.
Create-style extension idea: Blast furnace multiblock fed by funnels, heated by superheated blaze burners, air from encased fans (fans = preheaters). Slag out the back onto a belt.

What it does: Shapes items with swappable molds: plate, rod, wire, gear, bullet casing, packing 2×2/3×3, unpacking.
Interactions & automation: Mold right-clicked into the piston; items on its conveyor.
Create-style extension idea: Press dies: apply a die to the mechanical press by hand/deployer; recipe checks die. Compacting already covers packing.

What it does: Grinds ores to grit (doubling), stone to gravel/sand; kills mobs for drops.
Interactions & automation: Top input; front output; speed scales with power.
Create-style extension idea: Add crushing recipes for IE-style byproducts.

What it does: Strips then cuts logs to planks; sawdust byproduct; blade wears out.
Interactions & automation: Blade inserted by hand; redstone stops.
Create-style extension idea: Sawdust as a saw byproduct feeds fiberboard/paper.

What it does: Dissolves solids in fluids: liquid concrete, potions, herbicide, napalm.
Interactions & automation: Fluid in at base; items via rear hatches.
Create-style extension idea: Just add recipes.

What it does: Fills containers/molds on a conveyor; casts resin/graphite; oxidises copper with acid.
Create-style extension idea: Filling recipes + molds as items on the belt.

What it does: Ferments crops/sugars into ethanol.
Create-style extension idea: Fermenting basin: unheated mixing with a time requirement, or a lidded vat that works over time.

What it does: Presses seeds/fruit to plant oil; coke dust → HOP graphite.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Compacting in a basin (can output fluid)
Create-style extension idea: Compacting recipes.

What it does: Combines 1–2 fluids with a non-consumed catalyst: biodiesel, acetaldehyde, phenolic resin, gasoline, high-cetane biodiesel.
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Mixer with fluid inputs (no catalyst concept)
Create-style extension idea: Catalyst holder: a block/slot under or beside the basin whose item is checked but not consumed.

What it does: Auto-crafts up to 3 chained recipes; fluid tanks substitute buckets.
Runs blueprint recipes automatically.
High-power batch smelter: 12 inputs + 4 additive slots, alloying, ore doubling, recycling, slag; graphite electrodes wear out.
Interactions & automation: Inputs/additives through top hatches; outputs auto-pushed; electrodes by hand only.
Default numbers: 78 recipes; 25,600–512,000 Flux; electrodes last ~4 real days
Create-style extension idea: Arc crucible: a large heated vessel (superheated burners or a high-SU 'electrode drive') melting into molten metals poured via spout/basin — or kept close to IE with consumable electrodes.

Feature: Excavator + bucket wheel; core sample drill
What it does: Mines chunk-level mineral veins (not blocks) with a rotating bucket wheel; sample drill finds what vein a chunk holds.
Interactions & automation: Ore out at the rear; redstone panel.
Default numbers: Vein yield 38,400; spawn threshold 0.9; up to 20% pre-depleted
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Drills on contraptions mine actual blocks only
Create-style extension idea: Mineral veins + a kinetic bucket-wheel excavator and a hand-cranked core sampler. Very Create-flavoured.

What it does: Chunk loader that consumes paper.
Thermoelectric robot wolves.
Villager houses and illager variants with IE gear.
Hidden fluid reservoirs per chunk area: oil, aquifer water, lava; survey tool maps them.
Default numbers: Oil: weight 40, capacity 32.5M mB, min 2.5M, trace 6 mB/t. Aquifer weight 30, 10M mB. Lava weight 30, 1M mB
Create-style extension idea: Data-driven reservoirs + a seismic charge/survey item. Foundation for all petroleum.

What it does: Drills a well: concrete-reinforced pipes above bedrock, water-cooled below; then the well gushes under pressure.
Interactions & automation: Pipes by hand; concrete then water in; tank must be able to output or it blows.
Create-style extension idea: Drilling rig driven by rotation, pipe consumed per metre, concrete/water piped in. Gusher animation.

What it does: Pumps a depressurised well slowly and steadily; some wells replenish.
Interactions & automation: Sits on the wellhead; outputs on sides.
Create-style extension idea: Pumpjack driven directly by a shaft — perfect fit for Create's moving-parts look; mB/t scales with RPM.

What it does: Self-levelling large tank; configurable side ports.
Separates crude into fractions; re-distils kerosene.
Interactions & automation: Fluid in at base, fractions out the side, bitumen out the front.
Default numbers: Crude 60 mB → naphtha 15 + kerosene 20 + sulfur diesel 30 + lubricant 10 (+7% bitumen) per tick at 1,024 Flux. Kerosene 10 → benzol 5 + sulfur diesel 5
Create-style extension idea: Fractionating column built like a boiler: stacked segments over a heated base, one output per level.

What it does: Two drums cycle: load bitumen, heat to petcoke + sulfur diesel, drain, flush with water.
Interactions & automation: Phased cycle; bitumen locked out mid-cycle.
Default numbers: 2 bitumen + 125 mB water → 2 petcoke + 27 mB sulfur diesel; 15,360 Flux
Create-style extension idea: Coking drum multiblock with a visible fill/heat/dump cycle.

What it does: Desulfurises diesel and cracks naphtha / lubricant.
Default numbers: Sulfur diesel 1,000 + water 500 → diesel 1,000 + 5 sulfur (8,000 Flux). Naphtha 1,500 + water 500 → petroleum gas 2,000 (192,000 Flux). Lubricant 2,000 + water 500 → sulfur diesel 2,000 + 2 wax (256,000 Flux)
Create 6.0.10 equivalent: Superheated basin mixing could express these
Create-style extension idea: Superheated mixing recipes, or a pressurised reactor block if you want a bespoke machine.

What it does: Burns off any flammable fluid.
Create-style extension idea: Waste void — needed once byproducts pile up.

What it does: Small liquid-fuel generator; keeps contents when picked up.
Interactions & automation: Fuel from buckets/jerrycans/pipe; redstone stops it.
Create-style extension idea: Small gasoline engine as a light kinetic source.

What it does: Lubricated heavy machines run 25% faster; works on iron golems; plant oil is a weaker substitute.
Interactions & automation: Placed at a marked spot; can by hand.
Create-style extension idea: Lubrication as a Create mechanic: lubed machines get +speed or −stress. Strong fit.

What it does: Crude oil, naphtha, kerosene, diesel, sulfur diesel, lubricant, benzol, gasoline, napalm, petroleum gas.
Default numbers: Fuel burn times listed under Diesel generator
Create-style extension idea: Register under c: tags so other mods' fuels work in your engines.

What it does: Bitumen from distillation; asphalt concrete is a road block.
Create-style extension idea: Road blocks — fun, cheap.

What it does: Wax replaces honeycomb (candles, waxing copper). Petcoke = coke for steel/graphite.
Create-style extension idea: Petcoke slots into the steel chain.

What it does: Naphtha → petroleum gas → (with benzol) creosote / acetaldehyde → phenolic resin.
Create-style extension idea: Plastics tier after petrochem.

What it does: Throwable fire; fuel-powered boat with workbench upgrades.
Projects a hologram of any IE/IP multiblock to build against.
Create-style extension idea: Ship Ponder scenes for each machine.
